dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, is that the necklace which Ploy gave you?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz ðæt ðə ˈnɛkləs wɪtʃ ˈplɔɪ ˈɡeɪv juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. It has a little sun on it. She says it's like my character.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪt ˈhæz ə ˈlɪtəl ˈsʌn ɑːn ɪt. ʃiː ˈsɛz ɪts laɪk maɪ ˈkærɪktər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's sweet! Ploy is always so cheerful.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈswiːt! ˈplɔɪ ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈsoʊ ˈtʃɪrfəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She is. And she has a great sense of humor.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈɪz. ənd ʃiː ˈhæz ə ˈɡreɪt ˈsɛns əv ˈhjuːmər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My friend Top is more serious, but he's very easygoing, too.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈtɑːp ɪz ˈmɔːr ˈsɪriəs, bʌt hiːz ˈvɛri ˌiːziˈɡoʊɪŋ, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What did he give you for your birthday?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt dɪd hiː ˈɡɪv juː fər jʊr ˈbɜːrθdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: This book. It's a book which teaches you how to relax!
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ˈbʊk. ɪts ə ˈbʊk wɪtʃ ˈtiːtʃɪz juː ˈhaʊ tə rɪˈlæks!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! Maybe he thinks you're too serious!
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ˈmeɪbi hiː ˈθɪŋks jʊr ˈtuː ˈsɪriəs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe! He knows my character well.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi! hiː ˈnoʊz maɪ ˈkærɪktər ˈwɛl.
